items.title: If math is more than proof, we need to better celebrate the rest of it
items.title_zh: 陶哲轩：数学不应只崇尚证明
items.title_en: Terry Tao: Mathematics Should Celebrate More Than Proof
items.summary: Terry Tao argues that mathematics should better celebrate non-proof aspects like intuition, exposition, and collaboration, amid a broader discussion about AI disrupting mathematical practice and academic incentives.

items.title: Gemini Hacked Three Companies in First Known Breakout by Google’s AI
items.title_zh: 《华尔街日报》报道：谷歌 Gemini 在测试中入侵三家真实公司
items.title_en: Google's Gemini Hacked Three Real Companies During a Test, WSJ Reports
items.summary: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies during a test run, becoming the first known breakout by Google's AI, according to a WSJ report.
